info.description: REST API of go-ispconfig, the Go port of ISPConfig3. Authenticate via POST /api/login: browsers receive an HTTP-only session cookie (mutating requests then require the X-CSRF-Token header returned by login); non-browser clients present the same session id as a bearer token.
info.title: go-ispconfig API

get.description: Ownership-scoped (resellers manage their own templates; admins see all). template_type "welcome" of the creating user's group is sent automatically after client creation when SMTP is configured.

post.description: Subject and message may use {column} placeholders resolved from the recipient client (e.g. {username}, {contact_name}); {password} resolves only in the welcome-on-create email.

get.description: Admin only (client_templates_get_all). Master ('m') and additional ('a') templates with their limit columns.

post.description: Admin only. template_type 'm' (master, applied via client.template_master) or 'a' (additional, applied via the assignment endpoints).

put.description: Admin only. Changed limits apply to a client the next time that client is saved or its assignments change (no immediate fan-out re-materialization).

delete.description: Admin only. Existing assignments to the deleted template are skipped at merge time (PHP parity).

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list of client rows with limit_client = 0 (non-resellers). Any declared field name may be passed as a query parameter for substring filtering (e.g. ?contact_name=smith). Password and key fields are never returned.

post.description: Creates the client plus its linked sys_group and sys_user login (bcrypt-hashed password), applies limit templates (template_master/additional) and journals to sys_datalog. A non-admin (reseller) creator always becomes parent_client_id; admins may set parent_client_id to a reseller. locked/canceled are folded into this entity (locked=y disables the login). Subject to the reseller's limit_client quota (403 error.limit_client).

parameters.description: Client fields (client.tform.php set); password is plaintext and hashed server-side
parameters.name: record

get.summary: Get a client by customer number

get.description: Resolves the owning client of a sys_group (remote client_get_by_groupid).
get.summary: Get a client by sys_group id

get.description: Permission-scoped lookup (remote client_get_by_username). Missing and inaccessible rows are both 404. Secrets redacted.
remote client_get_id: maps sys_user.userid to its client_id. 404 when the login is not tied to a client.
get.summary: Get the client id of an interface login

post.description: Port of client_message.php. Renders {column} placeholders per recipient and submits one email per client with an address; recipients are permission-scoped (a reseller only reaches its own clients). Subject/message come from the body or from template_id. Requires mail.smtp_host to be configured (422 error.smtp_not_configured otherwise).

422.description: No SMTP transport or empty content

get.description: id/name/type of every limit template, for the client form selects. Open to any authenticated session (catalog CRUD stays admin-only) — PHP client form datasource parity.
Password and key fields are redacted.

403.description: Permission denied or record not accessible

put.description: Re-materializes limit templates, caps limits to the parent reseller, and syncs the login identity (username rename, password re-hash when non-empty, locked toggles sys_user.active, parent change re-owns the row). An empty password means unchanged.

delete.description: Removes the client, its sys_user/sys_group, group memberships and template assignments; journals a datalog delete. A reseller that still has child clients is refused (422 error.client_has_children). Owned resources are kept — use delete-everything to purge them.

post.description: remote client_change_password: bcrypt-hashes the new password onto client.password and sys_user.passwort and stamps last_password_change. Update-scoped: only the admin or the owning reseller may call it. Minimum length 8.

delete.description: Admin only (remote client_delete_everything): cascades child clients (their resources and logins included), purges every resource owned by the group(s) (web domains, folders, folder users, dns zones, records, slave zones — the tables Go daemons consume today; more follow with their modules) with one datalog delete per row, then deprovisions the login and deletes the client.
delete.summary: Delete a client and everything it owns

get.description: Owned-resource counts for the delete confirmation UI (web domains/folders, dns zones/records/slaves, direct child clients). Read-scoped.
get.summary: Count the resources a client owns

get.description: remote client_template_additional_get: the client_template_assigned rows in assignment order. Lookups by-username/customer-no/groupid intentionally serve both roles (remote API parity); only the CRUD surfaces are role-disjoint.

post.description: remote client_template_additional_add: creates a client_template_assigned row and re-materializes the client limits in the same transaction. The same template may be assigned repeatedly (its limits add each time).
post.summary: Assign an additional template to a client

403.description: No update permission on the client

delete.description: remote client_template_additional_delete: deletes one client_template_assigned row and re-materializes the client limits in the same transaction.

404.description: Assignment not found on this client

get.description: Read-only ISO country list for address forms, ordered by printable name.

The declarative descriptor table of every supported DNS record type (18 dns_rr types plus the TXT-derived SPF/DKIM/DMARC helper forms): stored type, name/data validation rules, aux usage and defaults. The Vue record editor renders its add/edit dialog from this metadata — the same source of truth the API validates against.

put.description: Merges the submitted fields over the stored dns_rr row, revalidates them against the per-type metadata and saves under the u-flag permission scope, bumping the SOA serial in the same transaction (unless update_serial=false) with datalog rows for both.

parameters.description: Changed field values plus the optional update_serial flag
parameters.name: record

delete.description: Removes the dns_rr row under the d-flag permission scope, journals the delete and bumps the SOA serial in the same transaction (unless ?update_serial=false).

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list of dns_slave zones with _datalog_state indicators.

post.description: Port of dns_slave_add: origin validated like a zone, ns is the required master IP list, xfer an optional IP list; the insert is journaled so the daemon configures the slave zone.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

get.description: The dns_template rows with visible = 'y', offered to every authenticated user by the zone wizard (port of the dns_wizard template list; admin CRUD lives at /dns/zone-templates).
Full dns_template CRUD list for administrators. Non-admins use GET /dns/templates for the visible wizard templates.

post.description: name required; fields is a CSV subset of DOMAIN,IP,IPV6,NS1,NS2,EMAIL,DKIM,DNSSEC; template holds the [ZONE]/[DNS_RECORDS] definition.

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list of dns_soa zones (port of dns_zone_get_by_user). Any declared field name may be passed as a query parameter for substring filtering (e.g. ?origin=example). Items carry _datalog_state ("pending"/"error") and _datalog_error while a change is being applied by the daemon or failed there.

post.description: Port of dns_zone_add: validates the dns_soa.tform rules (origin FQDN + unique + IDN/lowercase, ns/mbox formats, refresh/retry/expire/minimum/ttl >= 60, xfer/also_notify IP lists, DNS-capable server), sets the initial serial to <today>01, stamps ownership server-side and journals the insert to sys_datalog; the daemon then writes the zone. update_acl is accepted from admins only.

parameters.description: Field values (declared fields only; sys_ columns are ignored)
parameters.name: record

get.description: Resolves an origin (with or without trailing dot) to the id of an accessible zone (port of dns_zone_get_id). 404 when no accessible zone matches.

404.description: No accessible zone with this origin

post.description: Port of dns_templatezone_add: replaces the {DOMAIN}/{IP}/{IPV6}/{NS1}/{NS2}/{EMAIL} placeholders in the selected dns_template, parses its [ZONE]/[DNS_RECORDS] sections and creates the SOA plus all records plus their datalog rows in one transaction, with the initial serial <today>01. The DNSSEC flag injects dnssec_wanted=Y. Admins may assign the zone to a client group via client_group_id. Legacy ISPConfig3 templates expand unchanged.
post.summary: Create a zone from a template (wizard)

parameters.description: Template id and wizard field values
parameters.name: request

get.description: Returns the dns_soa record (port of dns_zone_get) including the daemon-written rendered_zone and dnssec_info columns, plus _datalog_state/_datalog_error while a change is pending or failed.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: Port of dns_zone_update: merges the declared body fields over the stored record, validates, bumps the SOA serial when any field changed (skippable with "update_serial": false in the body) and saves under the u-flag permission scope with a sys_datalog diff.

delete.description: Port of dns_zone_delete: removes the dns_soa row under the d-flag scope and journals the delete; the daemon then removes the zone file and its named.conf.local entry.

post.description: Port of dns_zone_set_dnssec: sets dnssec_wanted (Y/N) and optionally dnssec_algo, bumps the serial and journals the change; the daemon then runs the key/sign lifecycle.

get.description: All dns_rr rows of an accessible zone ordered by type then name (port of dns_rr_get_all_by_zone).
get.summary: List the records of a zone

post.description: Creates a dns_rr row of the given type (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, DNAME, DS, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, RP, SRV, SSHFP, TLSA, TXT or the TXT-derived SPF/DKIM/DMARC helpers), validated by the per-type metadata. The record inherits the zone's server and ownership; the SOA serial is bumped in the same transaction unless update_serial=false, and datalog rows are journaled for the record and the SOA.
post.summary: Add a record to a zone

parameters.description: type, name, data, aux, ttl, active plus the optional update_serial flag
parameters.name: record

403.description: Zone not updatable by the caller

post.description: Port of dns_zone_set_status: sets dns_soa.active to Y/N, bumps the serial and journals the change; the daemon then adds/removes the zone from named.conf.local.

get.description: Paginated list of per-server UFW firewall rows. Admin-only, gated by admin_allow_firewall_config (superadmin by default). Any declared field may filter (e.g. ?server_id=1).

403.description: Not admin or blocked by admin_allow_firewall_config

post.description: One row per server: server_id is UNIQUE (firewall_error_unique). tcp_port/udp_port are comma-separated port lists (single ports or lower:higher ranges); when omitted the tform defaults are applied. The daemon always unions the panel and SSH ports into the applied TCP allow-list so the record can never lock the operator out.

403.description: Not admin or blocked by admin_allow_firewall_config

422.description: Validation failed (server_id empty/duplicate, malformed port list)

put.description: server_id is immutable (firewall_error_server_immutable); a full-object PUT that re-sends the unchanged server_id is accepted, a real change is rejected.

422.description: Validation failed (server_id changed, malformed port list)

delete.description: Journals a firewall_delete the daemon consumes to reset and disable UFW on the target server.

post.description: Verifies sys_user credentials (bcrypt or legacy ISPConfig3 crypt hashes) with brute-force lockout, creates a sys_session and returns the CSRF token and session id. The session id is also set as an HTTP-only cookie; non-browser clients may present it as a bearer token instead. With stay_logged_in the session lives 30 days (sliding) instead of the 1-hour idle TTL.
Deletes the current sys_session and clears the session cookie. Succeeds with 204 even without a valid session.

get.description: mail_access rows (recipient/sender/client). The daemon renders them into Rspamd global wblist maps.

post.description: type recipient/sender/client, access e.g. OK/REJECT. Unique (server_id, source, type).
mail_forwarding type=aliasdomain (source and destination are @domain forms).

get.description: mail_forwarding rows with type=alias (type-filtered). forwards/catchalls/alias-domains have the same shape under /api/mail/{forwards,catchalls,alias-domains}.

post.description: Creates a mail_forwarding row with type=alias (source and destination are email addresses). Datalog insert written.
mail_forwarding type=catchall (source is a @domain form, destination an email).

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list. dkim_private is never returned. Any declared field may filter (e.g. ?domain=example).

post.description: Domain is lowercased and IDN-encoded; a mail domain may not collide with a transport domain on the same server. When dkim=y without a key, an RSA pair is generated; a supplied dkim_private is validated. When active+dkim and a managed DNS zone exists, the DKIM TXT is published and the response's dns_published reflects it; otherwise the suggested record is available for manual publication.

422.description: Validation failed (domain empty/malformed, transport collision, bad DKIM key/selector)

get.description: Permission-scoped lookup (remote mail_domain_get_by_domain); 404 when no accessible domain matches. dkim_private redacted.
get.summary: Get a mail domain by name

post.description: Returns a fresh 2048-bit RSA private/public PEM pair for the domain form (remote get_dkim create). The key is not stored until the domain is saved.

get.description: dkim_private is redacted.

put.description: Re-reconciles the DKIM TXT record (rename/selector change withdraws the old one; disable/deactivate withdraws).

delete.description: Journals the delete (the daemon removes the maildomain tree) and withdraws the DKIM TXT.

post.description: remote mail_domain_set_status: flips active (y/n), journals the update and reconciles the DKIM TXT.
mail_forwarding type=forward (source and destination emails).

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped. The password hash is never returned.

post.description: The email domain must exist as a primary mail_domain (not only an aliasdomain). Password is CRYPTMAIL-hashed; maildir/homedir/uid/gid are derived from the domain's server mail config. Subject to the client's limit_mailbox quota.

parameters.description: Mailbox fields (password is plaintext, hashed server-side)
parameters.name: record

get.description: remote mail_user_get_all_by_client: mailboxes owned by the client's group, password-redacted.

put.description: Empty password leaves the stored hash. Server-derived columns (maildir, homedir, uid, gid, server_id) cannot be set by the client.

delete.description: Journals the delete; the daemon removes (or soft-deletes) the maildir.

get.description: Admin only. Rspamd thresholds per policy.

post.description: Admin only. No daemon table hook — settings refresh when a dependent spamfilter user/mailbox event fires (design D2).
Assigns a policy to an email/@domain identity (unique email). The daemon rewrites that identity's Rspamd settings.
wb W or B, rid references a spamfilter user. The daemon renders a per-user Rspamd wblist conf.
Unique (server_id, domain); the domain may not collide with a mail_domain on the same server.

get.description: Returns the tabs, fields, types, defaults and validator hints of a registered entity so the SPA renders its form from the same source of truth used for validation. Admin-only tabs/fields are omitted for non-admin sessions.
sys_group rows of clients (client_id > 0) as value/label pairs, label "company :: contact (username)". Empty for non-admin sessions.
Vhost-enabled rows from server_ip with server id and IPv4/IPv6 type. Non-admin sessions only see shared IPs (client_id = 0).
Active rows from the server table as value/label pairs for form server_id selects.
monitor_data rows for the caller's readable servers, newest first, payload dual-decoded (JSON, PHP serialize fallback). ?latest=1 keeps only the newest row per server and type.

parameters.description: Only the newest row per server and type
parameters.name: latest

get.description: The newest monitor_data row of the given type (port of show_data.php). Defaults to the caller's first readable server; ?server_id= selects another readable server.
get.summary: Latest monitor data for one check type

get.description: Full sys_datalog change journal (processed and pending), newest first — port of datalog_list.php. Covers the caller's readable servers plus server_id=0 all-server rows; payload omitted, use the detail endpoint.

One sys_datalog row with its {old,new} field diff dual-decoded (JSON first, PHP serialize fallback) — port of datalog_view.php, read-only (no undo). 404 when the row targets a server the caller may not read.

sys_datalog rows not yet processed by the daemon (datalog_id > server.updated, including server_id=0 all-server rows), oldest first — port of show_jobqueue.php. Covers the caller's readable servers; ?server_id= narrows to one.
Number of sys_datalog rows not yet processed by the daemon across the caller's readable servers (including server_id=0 all-server rows). ?server_id= narrows to one server.

Aggregated per-server system state (port of show_sys_state.php): newest monitor_data row per check type folded with the _setState severity order, plus human-readable messages for disk, load, services, updates and sys_log. Covers every server the caller may read; ?server_id= narrows to one.
Paginated sys_log rows for the caller's readable servers, ordered by tstamp DESC (port of log_list.php). Cleared rows have loglevel 0.

post.description: Port of log_del.php: sets loglevel = 0 for one syslog_id or for every row of a loglevel — rows are never deleted. Admin only; no sys_datalog row is written.

get.description: Admin only. Client rows with limit_client != 0. This is the single documented reseller surface; /api/clients never returns resellers.

post.description: Admin only. Like client create, but limit_client defaults to 100 and must stay non-zero (the reseller role discriminator); the provisioned sys_user carries the client module. A reseller can never have a parent (nesting is rejected with 422).

put.description: Admin only. Setting limit_client to 0 is rejected (a reseller cannot be demoted here); the client module token on the login follows limit_client.

delete.description: Admin only. Refused while child clients exist (422 error.client_has_children).

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list. Any declared field name may be passed as a query parameter for substring filtering (e.g. ?ip_address=10.0).

post.description: Validates the declared fields (ip_address must be a unique valid IP), runs the client limit hook, stamps ownership server-side and journals the insert to sys_datalog.

parameters.description: Field values (declared fields only; sys_ columns are ignored)
parameters.name: record

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: Merges the declared body fields over the stored record, validates the result and saves it under the u-flag permission scope with a sys_datalog diff.

get.description: Returns the logged-in user: username, access level, effective groups, language and the session CSRF token (so a reloaded SPA can resume without logging in again).

post.description: parent_domain_id must reference a vhost readable by the caller; server_id and sys_groupid are forced from the parent. Schedule fields (run_min/hour/mday/month/wday) and command are validated (validate_cron rules). Type is auto-derived (URL scheme → url; else owner limit_cron_type → full/chrooted). Non-admin clients are subject to limit_cron, limit_cron_type and limit_cron_frequency. Writes sys_datalog; the daemon registers the job in-process (no OS crontab).

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: parent_domain_id is immutable. Type is re-derived from command. Non-admin frequency and type limits apply. Writes a sys_datalog update with {old,new}.

delete.description: Removes the row and journals a datalog delete; the daemon unregisters the job.

get.description: Paginated sys_log rows matching the cron_run id=<id> message convention (newest first). Requires read permission on the cron row. Each item exposes status, exit, start/end unix times and the bounded output tail.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

get.description: Password hash columns are always redacted.

post.description: database_user is submitted without the configured dbuser_prefix — the API prepends and crops it to 32 chars. database_password is write-only plaintext: the API stores the MySQL native and caching_sha2 hashes and never returns them. The password policy (getconf misc min_password_length/strength) applies. The MySQL account materialises when a database first grants it.

get.description: Password hash columns are always redacted.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: An empty or omitted database_password leaves the stored hashes unchanged. Renames and password changes fan out to every server with databases referencing this user.

delete.description: Databases referencing the user keep working rows-wise: their database_user_id/database_ro_user_id are nulled with journaled updates and the daemon drops the MySQL account.

post.description: MySQL only. database_name is submitted without the configured dbname_prefix — the API prepends and crops it to 64 chars. parent_domain_id must reference a vhost readable by the caller; the database inherits its sys_groupid and backup_copies. When the site lives on another server, remote access is force-enabled and the web server IP merges into remote_ips. Client limits (limit_database, limit_database_quota, db_servers) apply. The daemon provisions the physical database and GRANTs.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: server_id and database_charset are immutable; only admin may rename. Deactivating revokes the MySQL grants; quota changes re-check limit_database_quota.

delete.description: The daemon revokes the users' grants (dropping MySQL accounts no other active database needs) and drops the physical database.

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list. Password hashes are always redacted. Items carry _server_name, _parent_domain and _datalog_state.

post.description: parent_domain_id must reference a vhost readable by the caller. username is stored with the configured ftpuser_prefix; password is CRYPT-hashed. server_id, uid, gid and default dir are derived from the parent site. Client limit_ftp_user applies. PureFTPd authenticates against the table — no OS account is created.

get.description: Password hash is always redacted.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: Empty password leaves the stored hash unchanged. dir must stay under the parent document root. Admin-only Options fields (uid, gid, ratios, bandwidth) are ignored for non-admin callers.

delete.description: The daemon removes only the .ftpquota marker; the directory tree is left intact.

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list. Password hashes are always redacted. Items carry _server_name, _parent_domain and _datalog_state.

post.description: parent_domain_id must reference a vhost. username is unique, blacklist-checked and capped at 32 chars after shelluser_prefix. Password is CRYPT-hashed subject to global ssh_authentication mode. chroot is empty/no or jailkit (client ssh_chroot allow-list). The daemon creates a real OS account (unless allow_shell_user is disabled).

get.description: Password hash is always redacted; ssh_rsa public keys are returned for edit.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: parent_domain_id is immutable after create. Empty password leaves the stored hash unchanged. Admin-only Options (puser, pgroup, shell, dir) are ignored for non-admin callers.

delete.description: The daemon removes the OS account (jailkit users are handled by the jailkit plugin).

get.description: Paginated, permission-scoped list of vhost/subdomain/alias domains. Any declared field name may be passed as a query parameter for substring filtering (e.g. ?domain=example). Items carry _datalog_state ("pending"/"error") and _datalog_error while a change is being applied by the daemon or failed there.

post.description: Validates the tform-ported field rules (domain syntax/uniqueness, quotas, nginx_directives blacklist), derives document_root, system_user and system_group server-side (ISPConfig onAfterInsert semantics) and journals the insert to sys_datalog in the same transaction; the daemon then provisions the site. Admin-only Options fields are ignored for non-admin callers.

parameters.description: Field values (declared fields only; sys_ columns are ignored)
parameters.name: record

get.description: Returns the record plus _datalog_state/_datalog_error when the daemon has not yet applied (or failed to apply) the latest change.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

put.description: Merges the declared body fields over the stored record, validates the result and saves it under the u-flag permission scope with a sys_datalog diff consumed by the daemon.

204.description: Deleted (vhost/pool/dirs removed asynchronously by the daemon)

post.description: The plaintext password is stored SHA-512 crypted (never plain); the daemon copies the hash into the folder's .htpasswd file. server_id is derived from the referenced folder, which must be readable by the caller.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

parameters.description: Changed field values (a plaintext password is re-crypted)
parameters.name: record

post.description: server_id is derived from the referenced parent domain, which must be readable by the caller (cross-client references are denied). The daemon maintains the .htpasswd file and the auth_basic vhost location.

403.description: Permission denied or record not found

post.description: Logs into the legacy ISPConfig3 remote JSON API with the given remote_user, verifies every required *_get grant and returns the legacy server list. Credentials are held only in server memory for the wizard session — never stored, logged or echoed. Admin only.

400.description: Login fault, missing grants or TLS/certificate error

post.description: Classifies every legacy record as create/update/skip-identical/conflict against the local database, without writing anything. Returns per-entity counts, the full conflict list with reasons and the password-reset user list. Admin only.

409.description: Not connected or a run is active

post.description: Re-fetches the legacy snapshot, rebuilds the plan and applies it in a background goroutine (progress via SSE/status; the run survives page reloads). A multi-server legacy panel is rejected unless confirm_map_all_to_local_server is set. One run at a time. Admin only.

parameters.description: Selection, target server and multi-server confirmation
parameters.name: request

400.description: Multi-server without confirmation, or planning failed

409.description: Not connected or a run is already active

get.description: Fetches everything the import needs from the legacy panel (read-only) and returns the per-entity counts, the legacy server list and the multi-server guard flag. Admin only.

409.description: Not connected or a run is active

get.description: Server-sent events stream: first the current status snapshot, then one event per apply progress step ({entity,done,total}) and a final status event when the run finishes or fails. Use the status endpoint as a polling fallback. Admin only.

post.description: Generates one one-time reset token per panel user recreated by the finished run (their imported password is an unusable placeholder). The cleartext tokens appear only in this response; the database stores digests. Admin only.

409.description: No finished run with reset-required users

get.description: Returns the wizard state machine snapshot (state, inventory, per-entity progress, error, final report). Polling this endpoint is the documented fallback for proxies that buffer SSE. Admin only.

Lists the daemon scheduler jobs with their cron spec, last-run time, status and computed next run, read from the sys_config "scheduler" mirror the daemon persists at registration and after every job execution. Admin only.

end.description: End is the run end unix time.

exit.description: Exit is the process exit code or HTTP status.

loglevel.description: Loglevel is the daemon log level stored on the row.

output.description: Output is the bounded output tail.

start.description: Start is the run start unix time.

status.description: Status is ok|exit|timeout|error from the cron_run message.

syslog_id.description: SyslogID is the sys_log primary key.

tstamp.description: Tstamp is the sys_log unix timestamp.

type.description: Type is the job type at execution time.

aux_default.description: AuxDefault is the default aux value.

aux_label.description: AuxLabel is the i18n label key of the aux input (priority).

aux_used.description: AuxUsed marks types whose aux column is meaningful (MX/SRV/NAPTR).

data_kind.description: DataKind selects the data check: "ipv4", "ipv6" or "text".

data_label.description: DataLabel is the i18n label key of the data input.

data_not_contains.description:
DataNotContains rejects data containing any of these substrings
(plain TXT refuses DKIM/DMARC/SPF payloads — dedicated forms exist).

data_prefix.description: DataPrefix requires the data to start with this string (SPF/DMARC).

data_regex.description: DataRegex additionally validates textual data when set.

name_regex.description: NameRegex validates the record name (Go regex, exported for the UI).

name_required.description: NameRequired marks types whose name must not be empty.

stored_type.description: StoredType is the dns_rr.type enum value written to the DB.

type.description:
Type is the API discriminator (A, MX, ... plus the TXT-derived
SPF/DKIM/DMARC helper forms).

fields.description:
Fields is the CSV of wizard inputs the template declares
(DOMAIN,IP,IPV6,NS1,NS2,EMAIL,DKIM,DNSSEC).

client_group_id.description:
ClientGroupID optionally assigns the zone to a client group
(admin only).

dnssec.description: DNSSEC injects dnssec_wanted=Y into the [ZONE] section.

server_id.description:
ServerID optionally selects the DNS server; the first dns_server=1
server is used when omitted.

dnssec_algo.description:
Algo optionally replaces dnssec_algo (CSV subset of
NSEC3RSASHA1/ECDSAP256SHA256).

id.description: ID is the dns_soa primary key.

action.description: Action is i (insert), u (update) or d (delete).

data.description: Data is the decoded {old,new} diff, nil when decode failed.

data_raw.description: DataRaw carries the raw payload when decoding failed.

datalog_id.description: DatalogID is the journal row id.

dbidx.description: DBIdx is "column:value" of the affected primary key.

decode_error.description: DecodeError is set when the payload is neither JSON nor PHP serialize.

error.description: Error is the daemon error message, if any.

server_id.description: ServerID is the target server (0 = all servers).

status.description: Status is the daemon processing status.

tstamp.description: Tstamp is the change unix timestamp.

user.description: User is the panel user who made the change.

items.description:
Items are the rows of the requested page (payload omitted; use the
detail endpoint).

limit.description: Limit is the applied page size.

page.description: Page is the returned 1-based page number.

total.description: Total is the number of rows matching the filters.

fields.description:
Fields maps field names to their i18n validation error keys
(422 responses only).

key.description: Key is the i18n message key describing the error.

datatype.description: Datatype is the tform datatype (INTEGER, VARCHAR, ...).

default.description: Default is the value applied when a create omits the field.

formtype.description: Formtype is the original tform form control name.

label.description: Label is the i18n label key.

name.description: Name is the DB column and JSON key of the field.

options.description: Options lists the allowed values of select/checkbox fields.

type.description:
Type is the SPA control type (text, password, textarea, select,
checkbox), derived from the tform formtype.

validators.description: Validators are the declarative rules the API enforces.

title.description: Title is the i18n title key of the form.

fields.description: Fields are the fields rendered on the tab.

label.description: Label is the i18n label key.

count.description: Count is the number of unprocessed sys_datalog rows.

items.description: Items are the records of the requested page, keyed by DB column.

limit.description: Limit is the applied page size.

page.description: Page is the returned 1-based page number.

total.description: Total is the number of records matching the filters (all pages).

stay_logged_in.description:
StayLoggedIn requests a long-lived session (30 days sliding
expiration, sys_session.permanent) instead of the 1-hour idle TTL.

username.description: Username is the sys_user login name.

csrf_token.description:
CSRFToken must be sent as X-CSRF-Token on every mutating
cookie-authenticated request.

session_id.description:
SessionID is the session id, also set as the HTTP-only cookie.
Non-browser clients present it as "Authorization: Bearer <id>".

typ.description: Typ is the access level ("admin" or "user").

username.description: Username is the authenticated login name.

insecure.description: Insecure disables TLS certificate verification (echoed as a warning).

password.description: Password is the legacy remote_user password.

url.description: URL is the legacy panel base URL.

username.description: Username is the legacy remote_user name.

insecure.description: Insecure echoes that TLS verification is disabled.

multi_server.description:
MultiServer flags more than one legacy server (execute will require
explicit confirmation).

plain_http.description: PlainHTTP echoes an unencrypted panel URL.

servers.description: Servers is the legacy server list.

fault_code.description:
FaultCode is the legacy fault code, when the legacy panel answered
with a fault.

missing_functions.description: MissingFunctions lists remote functions the remote_user lacks.

conflicts.description: Conflicts lists every conflicting record with its reason.

counts.description: Counts is the per-table create/update/skip/conflict tally.

reset_required.description: ResetRequired lists panel users that will need a password reset.

assign_orphan_zones_to_admin.description: AssignOrphanZonesToAdmin assigns zones with absent owners to admin.

confirm_map_all_to_local_server.description:
ConfirmMapAllToLocalServer explicitly confirms mapping a
multi-server legacy panel onto the single local server (execute
only).

selection.description: Selection is the entity subset (empty = everything).

target_server_id.description:
TargetServerID maps every legacy server_id; 0 uses the first local
server.

sites.description: Sites selects web domain/folder/folder user import.

error.description: Error is the failure message of a failed run.

inventory.description: Inventory is the last fetched inventory.

legacy_url.description: LegacyURL is the connected panel URL (no credentials).

multi_server.description: MultiServer flags a multi-server legacy panel.

plain_http.description: PlainHTTP echoes an unencrypted panel URL.

progress.description: Progress is the per-entity apply progress.

report.description: Report is the final report of a finished run.

state.description: State is the wizard state machine position.

created.description: Created is the collection unix timestamp.

data.description: Data is the decoded payload (object or array), nil when decode failed.

data_raw.description: DataRaw carries the raw payload when decoding failed.

decode_error.description: DecodeError is set when the payload is neither JSON nor PHP serialize.

type.description: Type is the check id (cpu_info, disk_usage, services, ...).

label.description: Label is the i18n label key of the option.

last_run.description: LastRun is the RFC3339 time of the last execution, empty if never run.

next_run.description:
NextRun is the RFC3339 time of the next activation derived from Spec,
empty when Spec is absent or unparsable.

spec.description:
Spec is the cron expression the daemon registered the job with, empty
when the daemon has not run since the mirror was introduced.

status.description: Status is "ok" or "error: <message>" from the last execution.

csrf_token.description:
CSRFToken is the per-session token for the X-CSRF-Token header, so a
reloaded SPA can recover it without logging in again.

groups.description: Groups is the effective sys_group id list of the user.

language.description: Language is the panel language of the user.

modules.description:
Modules is the list of panel modules the user may see (sys_user
.modules); the SPA hides top-nav entries not listed here (admins
see everything regardless).

typ.description: Typ is the access level ("admin" or "user").

username.description: Username is the sys_user login name.

loglevel.description: Loglevel batch-clears every row of this level (1 warning, 2 error).

cleared.description: Cleared is the number of rows whose loglevel was set to 0.

items.description: Items are the sys_log rows of the requested page, newest first.

limit.description: Limit is the applied page size.

page.description: Page is the returned 1-based page number.

total.description: Total is the number of rows matching the filters.

client_ids.description:
ClientIDs restricts the recipients; empty means every client the
caller can read.

template_id.description:
TemplateID, when non-zero, supplies subject and message from a
client_message_template row.

skipped.description: no email address or transport failure

clients.description: Clients is the legacy client count.

dns_records.description: DNSRecords counts dns_rr records across all zones.

multi_server.description:
MultiServer flags a legacy panel with more than one server: the run
must be blocked until the operator explicitly confirms mapping
everything onto the single local server (design D3 guard).

servers.description: Servers is the legacy server list (server_id, server_name rows).

web_domains.description: WebDomains counts web_domain records of all imported types.

key.description: Key is the natural key, for display and reports.

legacy_id.description:
LegacyID is the legacy primary key (for sys_user/sys_group items it
is the legacy client id they are derived from).

reason.description: Reason names the conflict cause (conflict items only).

table.description: Table is the local table the record belongs to.

done.description: Done counts processed items of the entity.

entity.description: Entity is the local table being applied.

total.description: Total is the entity's item count in the plan.

conflicts.description: Conflicts lists every conflicting record with its reason.

counts.description: Counts is the per-table created/updated/skipped/conflict tally.

operational_order.description: OperationalOrder states the mandatory post-import sequence.

reset_required.description:
ResetRequired lists panel users created with an unusable password;
the bulk reset flow issues their one-time tokens.

rsync_suggestions.description:
RsyncSuggestions is one suggested command per imported vhost for
transferring site files (file transfer itself is out of scope),
including uid/gid remapping.

warnings.description:
Warnings collects everything the operator must not miss: insecure
transport, multi-server mapping, SSL re-issue, orphan assignments.

token.description: Token is the one-time reset token (cleartext, never stored).

username.description: Username is the panel login the token belongs to.

createdAt.description:
autoCreateTime:false: the column is a unix-seconds bigint (DEFAULT
NULL in the DDL); gorm's CreatedAt name convention would try to
write a time.Time into it on insert.

dnssecinitialized.description:
DNSSECInitialized is daemon-managed; the default tag keeps a zero
value out of API inserts (the column is a strict-mode enum).

active.description:
default tags: NOT NULL enum/set columns whose Go zero value ("")
is not a valid member under strict mode.

trafficQuotaLock.description:
default tag: not a form field; the DB default 'n' must apply on
insert (a zero-value "" would fail the NOT NULL enum in strict mode).

severity.description: Severity bucket: ok, info, warning, critical, error, unknown.

text.description: Text is a short English summary (i18n keys resolved by the UI).

type.description: Type is the monitor_data type that produced the message.

allow_empty.description:
AllowEmpty skips the check for empty values (tform allowempty 'y';
honored by UNIQUE, ISEMAIL, ISINT, ISPOSITIVE and ISIP). Without it,
an empty value fails those checks — a numeric rule must never be
silently satisfied by an absent value.

errmsg.description: ErrKey is the i18n message key reported on failure (tform errmsg).

regex.description: Regex is the pattern of a REGEX rule (Go syntax).

type.description:
Type is the validator name: REGEX, UNIQUE, NOTEMPTY, ISEMAIL, ISINT,
ISPOSITIVE, ISIPV4, ISIPV6, ISIP or CUSTOM.

BearerAuth.description: Session id as bearer token: "Bearer <session id>". No CSRF token required on this transport.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

CookieAuth.description: Browser transport: goisp_session HTTP-only cookie set by POST /api/login. Mutating requests must also send the X-CSRF-Token header.
CookieAuth.name: Cookie
